_meta.scope: every concrete public record under net.minestom.server.network.packet.** that implements net.minestom.server.network.packet.client.ClientPacket (direction "client", inbound — listened to by Packet { on "..." }) or net.minestom.server.network.packet.server.ServerPacket (direction "server", outbound)
